title: Fixed-head operator localization and conditional temporal-refinement audit
scientific_question: Is the remaining fixed-head Layer-ROM error caused primarily by state projection at internal interfaces, by the pointwise lower-boundary operator, or by reduced-model time propagation once the spatial state is held fixed?

scope.boundary: fixed zero pressure head at the 160-cm lower face, zero top flux

stage_E1_teacher_forced_operator_localiz.rule: Use only immutable committed R16 Reference states. No Layer-ROM state propagation occurs in E1.
stage_E1_teacher_forced_operator_localiz.state_projection: Exact volume-weighted layer mean theta from the immutable 16 x 10 cm committed Reference state.
stage_E1_teacher_forced_operator_localiz.internal_interface_candidate: Standard LARE adjacent-layer Darcy/Taylor interface flux using projected layer means, Mualem-Van Genuchten psi/K and the frozen thickness-weighted arithmetic face conductivity.
stage_E1_teacher_forced_operator_localiz.fine_face_diagnostic: At each candidate boundary that coincides with a 10-cm Reference face, compute the same Darcy face diagnostic from the two adjacent immutable fine-cell Reference theta states and arithmetic fine-cell conductivity. This is a spatial-operator diagnostic, not an independently logged Reference internal flux.
stage_E1_teacher_forced_operator_localiz.bottom_candidate: q_bottom = K(theta_bottom_layer) * [1 + (0 - psi(theta_bottom_layer))/(0.5*dz_bottom)] with positive-downward convention.
stage_E1_teacher_forced_operator_localiz.bottom_oracle: Logged immutable Reference terminal BOTTOM_FLUX at the same committed state and step.
stage_E1_teacher_forced_operator_localiz.constitutive_guard: Compare psi(theta_logged) with -h_logged and K(theta_logged) with the same frozen material constitutive law before interpreting operator differences.
response_vector: per material/member/interface RMS candidate-minus-fine-face diagnostic flux
per material/member/interface maximum absolute diagnostic flux error
R16_OP equal-grid internal-interface identity maximum absolute error
constitutive psi(theta) versus logged -h maximum absolute residual

interpretation.if_R16_identity_passes: The nonzero prognostic R16_OP error is not attributable to the instantaneous equal-grid spatial flux algebra. Proceed to frozen temporal-refinement E2.
interpretation.if_bottom_identity_fails: Stop before E2 and diagnose lower-boundary semantics/algebra. Do not retune a temporal integrator.
interpretation.if_internal_equal_grid_identity_fails: Stop before E2 and diagnose spatial operator mismatch.
interpretation.coarse_interface_error: Teacher-forced L4/L6/R8 internal-interface error localizes state-projection/closure burden without propagation drift.

stage_E2_conditional_temporal_refinement.execution_condition: E1 R16_OP equal-grid internal and bottom pointwise identity gates both pass.
stage_E2_conditional_temporal_refinement.integrator: unchanged source-anchored iterative Heun Layer-ROM research propagator
stage_E2_conditional_temporal_refinement.initial_states: exact same frozen B1H material/history initial states
stage_E2_conditional_temporal_refinement.closure: unchanged standard LARE internal and zero-head bottom operators
stage_E2_conditional_temporal_refinement.control: dt=0.0001 day must reproduce the immutable B1H R8 and R16_OP summaries to numerical tolerance before finer dt results are interpreted.
adjudication: Report every component separately by material, member and dt.
Temporal convergence is supported for a component only when its error is nonincreasing over the frozen dt ladder; no scalar convergence score.

If R16_OP errors collapse with dt refinement while E1 operator identity passes, classify the former R16_OP prognostic floor as a temporal research-integrator/propagation floor rather than a spatial closure floor.
If R16_OP errors persist despite E1 operator identity and dt refinement, investigate the reduced ODE/state-evolution formulation before altering boundary algebra.
Compare R8 and R16_OP at each dt as a vector; do not subtract their errors as an additive closure estimate.
